snippet.title: Left 4 Dead 2 - The Last Stand Update [Official Trailer]
snippet.description:
The official trailer for The Last Stand Update, coming to PC on September 24th.

It is official, this is the new content Left 4 Dead 2 will be receiving - but this is still not all! There will also be 30 new achievements, 2 brand new mutations and a plethora of bug and exploit fixes as well!
This update is a collaborative effort of 30+ community members working together with Valve over the course of 11 months to create new content for this beloved game, which will be available to all PC players as free DLC.

Thumbnail by Mittens: https://www.youtube.com/user/MultiSmitz
SFM segment animated by zeekrocz117: https://www.youtube.com/user/zeekrocz117/videos
Assistance by Niels_L: https://www.youtube.com/c/NielsL/videos
Design advice and assistance by Porky-da-Corgi: https://twitter.com/PorkydaCorgi
Music is Exodus by Iros Young (MagicMusicProduction): https://audiojungle.net/item/epic-trailer-intro/20938076

Make sure to check out our community hubs as well!
The Left 4 Dead Nation discord server is the central hub for anything L4D related, where you can hang out with the members of the update team as well: https://discord.gg/s9G9hWk
With all the new survival maps, it’s the perfect time to join the survival community and compete for world records! Check us out here: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/L4DSurvivalGroup
Want to hang out with the survival players who took part in this update? Check out Gold Miners: https://discord.gg/pGkQC8m

Left 4 Dead 1 & 2 are property of Valve corporation. All right reserved.

Re-uploading this trailer is not permitted unless explicit permission has been granted by the original creator (JAiZ), or the content falls under fair use.

For any PR-related inquiries, feel free to contact me through my YouTube associated e-mail, or on discord through JAiZ#0089
